name: Final Fantasy XI (LandSandBoat)

dev.what: The world server: LandSandBoat with OpenLobby's changes (PS2 consoles among them).
dev.back: FFXI's world database keeps what the dev world server's migrations changed in it; to go back exactly, restore the backup of it taken before switching to Dev (docs/deployer.md, "Dev channel").

env.name: LSB_ADVERTISE_IP
env.description: Address FFXI clients reach this host on (zone and search address). Empty: POL_ADVERTISE, then 127.0.0.1.

env.name: LSB_DB_NAME
env.description: LandSandBoat's MariaDB database.

env.name: LSB_DB_USER
env.description: LandSandBoat's MariaDB user.

env.name: LSB_DB_PASSWORD
env.description: LandSandBoat's MariaDB password. Change it.

env.name: LSB_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.description: MariaDB root password. Change it.

env.name: LSB_CLIENT_VER
env.description: The client version LSB expects (yyyymmdd_r).

env.name: LSB_VER_LOCK
env.description: LSB's VER_LOCK: 0 accepts every build, 1 exact, 2 at least.

env.name: LSB_SERVER_NAME
env.description: The world name, at most 15 characters.

env.name: LSB_ACCOUNT
env.description: The bridge's shared LSB account.

env.name: LSB_PASSWORD
env.description: That account's password. Change it.

env.name: FFXI_ACCT_SECRET
env.description: Seed of the per-member LSB passwords. Set once and keep.

env.name: FFXI_REQUIRE_SIGNED_IN
env.description: Refuse a launch no signed-in Viewer session accounts for.

env.name: FFXI_REQUIRE_SAME_ADDRESS
env.description: Attribute a launch only to a session from the same address.

env.name: FFXI_TOMBSTONE_DELETED
env.description: Rename deleted characters so their names can be reused.

env.name: BRIDGE_ADVERTISE_MAP
env.description: Per-client world address, "cidr=ip,...".

env.name: BRIDGE_IMPORT_PORT
env.description: The character-import endpoint's port; 0 disables it.

env.name: POL_FFXI_CHARACTER_SLOTS
env.description: FFXI Content IDs per handle (1 when empty).

env.name: POL_FFXI_MEMBER_SLOTS
env.description: FFXI characters per member in all (16 when empty).

env.name: POL_FFXI_WORLD_ID
env.description: The world id the title plugin serves.

env.name: HIPPAULBRIDGE_TAG
env.description: Version of the published bridge image (docker-compose.ghcr.yml).

volumes.name: lsb_navmeshes
volumes.description: LandSandBoat's pathfinding meshes (with lsb_ximeshes about 570 MB). External, so down -v never removes it.
setup: docker run --rm -v lsb_navmeshes:/navmeshes ghcr.io/landsandboat/ximeshes:latest sh -c 'echo pathfinding mesh files: $(ls /navmeshes | wc -l)'

volumes.name: lsb_ximeshes
volumes.description: LandSandBoat's zone geometry; the map server aborts at start without it.
setup: docker run --rm -v lsb_ximeshes:/ximeshes ghcr.io/landsandboat/ximeshes:latest sh -c 'echo zone geometry files: $(ls /ximeshes | wc -l)'

notes: Needs no files from the client on the server: the world is LandSandBoat's own prebuilt image. The client must be the version LSB_CLIENT_VER names when LSB_VER_LOCK is not 0. The title plugin (ffxititle) is required: without it the world connect fails with POL-0001. FFXI must be in the core's POL_LOBBY_CONTENT_IDS for the Play button. docker-compose.lsb-test.yml (a second world) is not part of this entry.

diagnose.say: The FFXI servers cannot sign in to their database. LSB_DB_PASSWORD in the FFXI .env is not the password the database was created with: MariaDB takes it from .env only the first time it starts.
diagnose.fix_about: Signs in to the database as root (LSB_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD) and sets the database user's password to LSB_DB_PASSWORD, then restarts the FFXI servers. Nothing is deleted.
